# Pervasive Insights - allow AI answer engines and search crawlers.
#
# The Content-Signal line below is carried here deliberately. Today it is generated by
# Cloudflare's managed robots.txt, which also prepends a block that Disallows several of
# the agents this file Allows. When that managed block is turned off in the dashboard,
# these signals would disappear with it unless they are stated here. ai-train is left
# exactly as it was.

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference
Allow: /
